label: Pattaya
short_description: North Pattaya and Wong Amat to the Jomtien coast on Thailand's Eastern Seaboard.
intro: Pattaya's hotels in this directory line the Eastern Seaboard beach city about two hours southeast of Bangkok: North Pattaya and the quieter Wong Amat headland, plus resorts toward the Jomtien coast. A long-established resort and convention destination, Pattaya suits beach, family and MICE stays, and is reached via U-Tapao (UTP) airport or the motorway from Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi.
